name: prompt-input
description: The chat composer: auto-growing text box, a tools row (mode, model, attachments) and a submit / stop button.

intent.Sm: Compact composer-toolbar trigger: height/control-touch/sm + height/control/sm, text-body-xs, hugs its value.

tokens.Submit: A Button (default); its tokens are Button's.

properties.value: Textarea needs a placeholder and an accessible name
Enter sends, Shift+Enter new line, Esc stops a stream (panel)

constraints: Always show the current model in the tools row.
While streaming the submit button becomes Stop — keep it enabled.
Disable send when the box is empty.

knownIssues.issue: Open flag (design-patterns.md): The chat composer look is applied by the Ask AI screen with className overrides.
knownIssues.workaround: The spec keeps the tokens below until the flag is decided; drift-check #14 allows only these.

notes: Installed 2026-09-22 with AI Elements for the chat panel. Stock source adapted to Enpath: Phosphor icons, light-only classes, shadcn colour names rewritten to Enpath tokens.

changelog.change: Text uses Enpath text styles (text-body-sm, text-heading-md …, see Foundations/Text Styles) instead of mixed size and weight classes. Labels (label-*) and small headings (heading-sm/xs) are Medium 500.
Story examples use text styles (text-body-sm, text-heading-xs …) instead of mixed size and weight classes; overrides that replaced the component's own text style (e.g. Label) removed.
PromptInputSelectTrigger size="sm" for the composer toolbar (mode / model selects); the chat panel used a hand-set h-7 before.
Submit is a Button. The composer look is an Open flag.

docs.intro:
# PromptInput

The chat composer: auto-growing text box, a tools row (mode, model, attachments) and a submit / stop button.

---

sections.title: What it is
sections.body:
AI Elements PromptInput, a form built on InputGroup. Enter submits, Shift+Enter adds a line. PromptInputSubmit shows send, spinner (submitted), stop (streaming) or error.

**Exports:** `PromptInputProvider` · `LocalReferencedSourcesContext` · `PromptInputActionAddAttachments` · `PromptInputActionAddScreenshot` · `PromptInput` · `PromptInputBody` · `PromptInputTextarea` · `PromptInputHeader` · `PromptInputFooter` · `PromptInputTools` · `PromptInputButton` · `PromptInputActionMenu` · `PromptInputActionMenuTrigger` · `PromptInputActionMenuContent` · `PromptInputActionMenuItem` · `PromptInputSubmit` · `PromptInputSelect` · `PromptInputSelectTrigger` · `PromptInputSelectContent` · `PromptInputSelectItem` · `PromptInputSelectValue` · `PromptInputHoverCard` · `PromptInputHoverCardTrigger` · `PromptInputHoverCardContent` · `PromptInputTabsList` · `PromptInputTab` · `PromptInputTabLabel` · `PromptInputTabBody` · `PromptInputTabItem` · `PromptInputCommand` · `PromptInputCommandInput` · `PromptInputCommandList` · `PromptInputCommandEmpty` · `PromptInputCommandGroup` · `PromptInputCommandItem` · `PromptInputCommandSeparator`
